title: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance
shortDescription: Mortal Kombat: Deadly Alliance helps define a Game Boy family fighting path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Makes a documented fighting option easier to find in the Game Boy family path.
Keeps the external item link distinct from the deterministic catalog method.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Recorded for the Game Boy family fighting discovery path using the preserved Wikidata entity record; this remains a labeled reference path, not a popularity claim.
